{"CommandLine":"python -c "
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from ultralytics import YOLO

model = YOLO(r'D:\acceleration\best.pt')
pm = model.model
pm.eval()

img = Image.open(r'D:\acceleration\dataset\val\rust\rust_00003.png').resize((224, 224)).convert('RGB')
t = torch.from_numpy(np.array(img, dtype=np.float32)/255.0).permute(2,0,1).unsqueeze(0)
t.requires_grad = True

features, grads = [], []
def fh(m, i, o): features.append(o)
def bh(m, gi, go): grads.append(go[0])

h1 = pm.model[8].register_forward_hook(fh)
h2 = pm.model[8].register_full_backward_hook(bh)

out = pm(t)
top = int(out[0].argmax())
print('Predicted top class:', top, 'names:', model.names)
print('Output logits:', out[0].detach().cpu().numpy())

out[0, top].backward()
h1.remove()
h2.remove()

f = features[-1][0].detach()
g = grads[-1][0].detach()
print('Feature shape:', f.shape, 'min/max:', f.min().item(), f.max().item())
print('Grad shape:', g.shape, 'min/max:', g.min().item(), g.max().item())

weights = g.mean(dim=(1, 2), keepdim=True)
cam_raw = (weights * f).sum(dim=0)
print('cam_raw min/max:', cam_raw.min().item(), cam_raw.max().item())
cam_relu = F.relu(cam_raw).cpu().numpy()
print('cam_relu min/max:', cam_relu.min(), cam_relu.max())
